Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us
The patient shows a markedly elevated NT-proBNP, suggesting possible heart failure or significant cardiac strain. Mild hypoglycemia and low total CO₂ may indicate metabolic or respiratory compensation. All other hematological, renal, hepatic, and lipid parameters are within normal limits. No acute myocardial injury is evident (normal troponin). Recommend clinical correlation for cardiac status and assessment for heart failure or volume overload.
Provider Organization: Krankenhaus der Barmherzigen Schwestern Ried
